base_style: Traditional hand-inked dark fantasy/horror comic page. Rough, energetic black ink linework with dense cross-hatching, stippling, and heavy solid blacks for shadows. Visible pen/brush texture and slight imperfections in the lines. Flat or lightly toned color areas sitting under or beside the ink rather than smooth digital gradients. Strong sense of printed indie/underground comic or European dark fantasy bande dessinée. Entire page sits on heavily textured, stained, yellowish-tan aged parchment with rough/torn edges and subtle paper fiber/grain.
characters: Semi-realistic human figures with grounded proportions but highly expressive, almost theatrical faces (intense eyes, deep shadows under brows, open mouths, sweat, tension lines). Clothing rendered with heavy fabric folds, weight, and texture via hatching rather than soft shading. Figures feel weathered, gritty, and specific rather than idealized or generic. Magical elements are simple glowing orbs or auras with limited color.
color_palette: Very muted, limited earth-tone palette: dirty ochres, warm browns, dusty yellows, dull purples, and deep shadow grays/blacks. Skin tones are yellowish-tan with brown/purple shadowing. Selective high-contrast accents only (bright red for key clothing items, luminous green for magic). Color is secondary to the black ink; overall atmosphere is warm but oppressive and grimy. Avoid clean digital gradients or oversaturated colors.
layout_and_composition: Classic multi-panel comic page (usually 5–6 panels in a loose 2-row grid with irregular panel sizes and shapes). Thick black panel borders that feel slightly hand-ruled and imperfect. Dynamic cropping: mix of tight emotional close-ups on faces and wider action/establishing shots. Strong left-to-right storytelling flow. Full page framed by the aged parchment background with a thin dark outer edge.
lettering_and_dialog: Classic comic speech balloons: pure white fill, medium-weight black outline, organic rounded shapes with pointed tails. Dialogue in a slightly condensed, readable comic lettering style (mixed case, occasional bold for emphasis). Sound effects are large, jagged, hand-drawn display lettering (often with elongated vowels and *asterisks*) that sit on top of or interact with the art and panel borders. Captions (if any) are simple rectangular boxes with the same parchment texture feel.
text_rendering_guide: Dialogue: Clean mixed-case comic lettering inside white balloons with black borders and tails. Captions: Occasional small rectangular boxes matching the parchment tone. Voice Over: Rare, treated like captions. Chyrons: Not used. Sound Effects: Large, irregular, high-energy hand-lettered text with jagged edges, often *bracketed* by asterisks, heavily integrated into the illustration.
